description: `review_focus.csv` = rows whose canonical primary is exactly **`primary_card_type_exact`** (here **BDC Chrome Prospect · Orange /25**). Sort **BDC# 1–200** then price (`bdc_then_price_asc`). Set **`review_focus_scope`: `all`** for the full scored pool. Fast refresh: `python3 -m cardmatch --input pilot_scored_full.csv --review-focus-only --output-dir <dir>`.
